title: Reject suppressed kernel read-ahead on wide Uniform spill readers
question: Can per-descriptor advice reduce constrained time or process CPU during the wide single terminal merge?
summary: Median elapsed rose 57.29% and process CPU rose 6.34%. File-cache refault events fell 92.74% with unchanged managed spill traffic. Removed the opt-in candidate.

workloads: 8 GiB Uniform Shuffle to eight exact Balanced parts. 197 runs, one merge, one worker, m256, 1 GiB hard without swap.

validation.summary: Three alternating fully verified pairs. Separate 2 GiB instrumented run verified all 197 successful advisory calls on controlled spill descriptors.

limitations: Kernel event and GNU time file input counters have distinct scopes from managed data movement and physical I/O.
exclusions: Warmup pair, small preflight, separate 2 GiB advice-call qualification and separate 8 GiB CPU profile.
reopen_when: Keep this advice disabled for the measured path. Test different application-level read batching separately if budget and traffic support it.
